lines.en: I call up Makoto and the two of us make plans to meet up for coffee, which quickly evolves into “Meet up for coffee and walk around the park” as if I didn’t just walk several miles to meet her.
lines.zh: 我给 Makoto 打电话，我俩约好见面喝咖啡，而这很快演变成「见面喝咖啡 + 绕公园散步」——就好像我不是刚走了好几英里来见她似的。

lines.en: Regardless, she pays for my drink with her dirty, porn money so everything works out in the end except for the one small fact that I am still not allowed to actually contribute to her porn money fund.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，她用她那脏脏的、卖色情用品挣来的钱给我买了饮料，所以最后一切都很圆满，只有一个小事实没变：我依然不被允许为她的色情资金添砖加瓦。

lines.en: I’m sure that will change sooner or later given that we’re now sexually involved and going on what could only be described as “dates” this early in the morning.
lines.zh: 我确信这迟早会变——毕竟我们现在已经有了性关系，还在大清早进行着只能被称作「约会」的活动。

lines.en: But for now, I will keep my head held high and remain as hopeful as a man in my position could possibly be.
lines.zh: 但眼下，我会昂着头，保持一个处在我这个位置的男人所能有的最大希望。

lines.en: We do a few laps around the park and wind up passing by Otoha several times, who’s busy playing her guitar in the usual spot.
lines.zh: 我们在公园里转了几圈，好几次路过 Otoha，她正忙着在老地方弹吉他。

lines.en: It becomes awkward after the third time we pass her and we all make a silent agreement to ignore each other’s presence for the rest of the morning.
lines.zh: 第三次路过她之后气氛变得尴尬，我们三方达成了沉默的共识：整个上午都当彼此不存在。

lines.en: Makoto seems embarrassed at first to be seen together, but quickly gets over this by amping herself up and repeatedly mentioning how normal it is for a teacher and his assistant to get coffee together.
lines.zh: Makoto 一开始被看到我们在一起有点难为情，但很快就靠给自己打气克服了——她反复念叨老师和他的助理一起喝咖啡有多正常。

lines.en: She gets more embarrassed when I mention how abnormal it is for those two people to have sex.
lines.zh: 我提到这两个人上床有多不正常时，她更尴尬了。

lines.en: And then she gets very mad when I suggest that we go do that instead of continuing our walk.
lines.zh: 而当我提议我们别散步了、去干那件事时，她非常生气。

lines.en: I feel like it’s a strange thing to get mad about as it is in stark contrast to the way I treated sex with her in the early stages of our relationship, but I suppose this is just something we won’t see eye to eye on.
lines.zh: 我觉得为这个生气挺奇怪的，因为在我们关系的早期，我对待跟她上床的态度跟现在截然相反，不过我想这就是我们永远谈不拢的事之一。

lines.en: Regardless, we do a few more laps (No sex involved) before heading our separate ways and getting on with our respective days.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我们又转了几圈（没有性），然后各走各的，继续各自的一天。
Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]！
